newsitem.title: USA: Orange & Rockland sets marketing with USGen.
newsitem.headline: Orange & Rockland sets marketing with USGen.

text.p: U.S. Generating Co said it is establishing a marketing initiative with Orange & Rockland Utilities Inc to purchase and sell electricity on the open market in the northeast United States.

The contract calls for USGen Power Services LP, USGen's power marketing affiliate, to manage day-to-day transactions, which include wholesale electricity purchases and sales between USGen Power Services, O&R and third parties.
The agreement also contemplates fuel transactions that will take advantage of changing market conditions, USGen said.

It said both companies expect the arrangement will create savings for O&R and provide market opportunities that will strengthen both companies' competitive prospects as the power generation sector in the electricity market deregulates.

O&R chief executive Louis Peoples said "The fact that O&R's customers will share in any savings attributable to this new effort is a major motivator for us as we seek to prosper in the competitive power market."

The joint effort calls for the companies to optimize the use of assets, fuel purchases, electricity purchases and financial trades in the New England Power Pool, the New York Power Pool and the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnection Association market areas, USGen said without providing any details.
USGen Power Services will manage the transactions through a series of bilateral contracts under existing arrangements approved by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.
USGen is partnership of PG&E Corp and Bechtel Enterprises Inc.
